question:
Read the sentence carefully and select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part.

The __clamour__ distracted the priest and made him angry.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"clamour"** means a loud and confused noise, especially that of people shouting. (कोलाहल)

 
 
• **Example:** The **clamour** of the crowd drowned out the speaker's voice.
 
 
 
• **"loud and confused noise"** refers to a sound that is both high in volume and disorganized, making it hard to concentrate or hear anything else. (तेज़ और भ्रमित करने वाली आवाज़)
 
 
• **Example:** The** loud and confused noise **from the construction site made it hard to focus on my work.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Introduction of new things** (नए चीजों का परिचय): The act of bringing something new into use or practice.

 
 
• **Example:** The introduction of new things in the curriculum has made learning more interesting.
 
 
 
• **Humorous deception** (हास्यपूर्ण धोखा): The act of deceiving someone in a funny or amusing manner.
 
 
• **Example:** His humorous deception during the magic show left the audience in splits.
 
 
 
• **Narrow-mindedness** (संकीर्ण मानसिकता): The quality of having a limited or closed perspective; not willing to consider different ideas.
 
 
• **Example:** His narrow-mindedness prevents him from accepting new and innovative ideas.
 
 

44:Tc32,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
